ports.note: Every layer port, on every map, whatever its parameters say. The ports used to vary with an inputMode parameter -- reasoningInput, rasterInput, polygonInput, networkInput were four separate declarations of that -- so the port a connection needed might not exist on the node. Which renderer draws is now read from what is wired: src/core.ts#drawnMode.

ontology.note: Map presentation plan and MapView activity are implemented; broader map artifact and cartographic contracts remain open. 0.11.0 declared fw:MapSpecification and the fifteen encoding properties here. That was wrong: emits records what the module named in implementation.definition asserts, and this widget is defined in src/core.ts#TYPES, which asserts nothing. The encoding terms are asserted by src/map-communication.ts and are gated by validate:ontology-coupling, which holds at zero undeclared. A release file is immutable, so 0.11.0 keeps the over-declaration and this one corrects it.

changes.description: Configure… draws the map it configures: the last run, with the dialog's settings, beside them, before Apply, so a mark's size or a basemap is seen as it is chosen (the practitioner, 2026-11-10). PMTiles are imported in Configure…, not the Inspector, which keeps only Name, Inputs, Settings and Result. Lines between records are coloured by the generation of the record they run into, counted as the transmission tree counts it, on one ramp with Chart's tree (magma 0.15 to 0.65, each step at least 3:1), and keyed by generation. A layer carrying a timeline of days plays through them on the interactive map: each day's polygons and the points dated up to that day, with that day's caption. The note under an interactive map no longer describes travel times on a map that has none.

evidence.note: Repository regression coverage exists; this release entry does not certify a widget independently. The self-description added in 0.17.0 is covered by tests/artifact-notes.test.mjs (13 unit checks, including that nothing machined numbers its own artifact or calls itself a caption, that an unnamed artifact is left unnamed rather than titled, and that a unit is stated once) and by tests/equation-notes.browser.mjs over the South London example on Chromium and WebKit. Both were mutation-checked by reintroducing the behaviour they forbid. 0.21.1: tests/value-classes.test.mjs checks that 98 parts of 16 units give the 16 units' breaks, with no equal breaks and no empty class, and that two units sharing a name still count twice. 0.22.0: tests/map-links.test.mjs (4 unit checks: Hagelloch's 188 records as 94 drawn, 90 at one place and 4 naming nothing; every outcome counted exactly once; lines stopped short of the mark and hidden with their layer; the receipt's facts) and tests/map-links.browser.mjs and tests/hagelloch-chains-example.browser.mjs on Chromium. 0.23.0: tests/map-links.test.mjs checks each of Hagelloch's 94 lines carries the tree's generation and its colour; tests/map-links.browser.mjs checks the preview draws 188 marks and follows the radius before Apply, PMTiles in Configure… and the key by generation; tests/hagelloch-cluster-example.browser.mjs checks the replay plays, 32 cases on 21 November; tests/tile-import.browser.mjs checks the import from Configure…. Chromium.
